## [1.4.0](https://github.com/ToThangGTVT/morphe-fb-lite/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0) (2026-10-01)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Fit the feed font to each device's system font ([b61b372](https://github.com/ToThangGTVT/morphe-fb-lite/commit/b61b37201ed9352590c080de1767e6c47c877924))

### ✨ New Features

* Add "Morphe settings" patch with a font size slider ([c825d1d](https://github.com/ToThangGTVT/morphe-fb-lite/commit/c825d1d0faaa71580ef2a040e7770d9c5d9e3b61))
* Add "Video download and auto next reel" patch ([9f9398d](https://github.com/ToThangGTVT/morphe-fb-lite/commit/9f9398d16bbc89b30c4bd3cb04375d343fa15687))
* Skip sponsored reels ([42821dd](https://github.com/ToThangGTVT/morphe-fb-lite/commit/42821dd6f5e76944b279ab0945f9c576b8c7aba0))

patches.name: Hide sponsored posts
patches.description: Hides sponsored posts in the news feed and skips sponsored reels.

patches.name: Install beside Meta's apps
patches.description: Lets the patched app install while Facebook, Messenger or other Meta apps are installed, by renaming the permissions it shares with them.

patches.name: Morphe settings
patches.description: Adds a settings screen to the app icon's long-press menu, with a font size slider.

patches.name: Use system font
patches.description: Blocks the downloaded Meta fonts (Optimistic, Instagram Sans, emoji, ...) so the app falls back to the system font.

patches.name: Use system font in feed
patches.description: Draws feed text with the system font instead of the font the server sends.

patches.name: Video download and auto next reel
patches.description: Adds a button to download the playing video, and moves to the next reel when one ends. Both are switched in the Morphe settings screen.
